messages.author: Aino Ahola
messages.text: TRN-063 had no traffic after the SFP change this morning, is it fixed?

messages.author: Veikko Vikkelä
messages.text: Yes. Link was up, counters at zero. Erkki told me last time that on these older boxes you just bounce the port instead of rebooting, so I did that and it worked.
